props.gloss_en: the mishna: one who plows any amount [on Shabbat] is liable
[plowing any amount] -- what is it fit for? it is fit for a pumpkin seed
the corresponding case in the Mishkan: for [such plowing] is fit for a single stalk of herbs [for dyes]
